titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 35: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 35. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number ⲗⲉ is printed with a bar above and below as the frame, not as a supralinear stroke. Measured strokes over ⲛ of the first ⲛⲓⲱⲧ (668–681) and of the second (1209–1221); the second ⲓ has no diaeresis (4×).
Measured strokes over ⲃ of ⲁⲩⲑⲃⲓⲟ (688–700, ⲃ 75 %, ⲑ not covered) and the first ⲙ of ⲙⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ (747–760).

Line in ekthesis with an enlarged ⲡ.

A wide blank (about 165 px), not marked by the editors, stands before the enlarged ⲡ of ⲡⲙⲁϩⲥⲛⲧⲉ.
